name: Costa Variety Improvement Program
description: Costa's blueberry breeding programme, based at Corindi, New South Wales, and led by Dr Jessica Scalzo since 2013. It screens roughly 20,000 seedlings a year, retains one to two per cent, works on a seven to ten year timeline and releases one to two new varieties a year. Since 2026 it is brand-fronted by BluGenix.

attributes.location: Corindi, Mid North Coast, New South Wales, Australia
attributes.germplasm_bank: described as the largest blueberry germplasm bank in Australia
